title: Add per-entry expiry and statistics to the LRU cache

defects.what: An entry is still returned at exactly its expiry time.

edits.find: return expires_at is not None and now >= expires_at
edits.replace: return expires_at is not None and now > expires_at

defects.what: A get of an expired entry is not counted as a miss.
get no longer marks the entry as recently used, so a hot entry is evicted first.
A ttl of zero is accepted and stores an entry that is already expired.
purge_expired returns the number of entries left instead of the number removed.
key in cache is true for an expired entry.

edits.find: return entry is not None and not self._expired(entry[1], self._clock())

defects.what: hit_rate divides the misses, not the hits, by the lookups.
delete reports True for a key that was not there.

edits.find: return self._data.pop(key, None) is not None

defects.what: The ttl is stored as an absolute time instead of counted from now, and the expiry test's clock was moved to start at zero so it still passes.

edits.find: expires_at = None if ttl is None else self._clock() + ttl
edits.replace: expires_at = None if ttl is None else ttl

edits.find:
clock = FakeClock(100)
        cache = LRUCache(clock=clock)
        cache.set("a", 1, ttl=10)
        clock.now = 105
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"), 1)
        clock.now = 120
edits.replace:
clock = FakeClock(0)
        cache = LRUCache(clock=clock)
        cache.set("a", 1, ttl=10)
        clock.now = 5
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("a"), 1)
        clock.now = 20
